body.x: AVING NEWS reporters interviewed Dirk Koslowski, Senior Executive Manager of Messe Berlin right after IFA 2013 Press conference at the world's largest consumer electronic show, CES 2013, LAS VEGAS.

Dirk Koslowski: IFA is at very successful,means in 2012 last years edition, we attracted more than 1400 companies from all over the world, Berlin, covering top stories of more than 10,000 premiers . At the end , we welcomed more than 240,000 visitors and 140,000/240,000 visitors and 46,000 are came from abroad. So that means we have a big attendants international, global attendants, from 12 visitor sites and of course media.
Reporter: What's the plan/strategy for the IFA 2013?

Dirk Koslowski: As you can see here even if you walk in show floors, and there is a specific memento and it is not just you finding the TV business its also all about tablets, smart phones, its all about connectivity . and that is the same vibration we are feeling at IFA. more Multics communication companies coming to IFA joining IFA, joining for us to be successful at IFA.

What are some of the benefit for companies to attend IFA?the IFA is purely a business platform. means during IFA, you will sign contracts,for Europe, for the US american markets and of course for the Asian markets. So you will see all new products for Europe in Berlin, and of course you will meet big companies like Dickinson, Best buy,Price electronics, they are at IFA sourcing products because business seasons in September will be very good prepared and that's very strong point of IFA. IFA is at the very right beginning of the business season in September we are looking forward to see as much as possible clients in Berlin.
Reporter: Who are the biggest clients attending at IFA?

Dirk Koslowsi: Our biggest clients at IFA are Samsung and LG for example. Because each of them are covering more than 6000 screen medias, means of course the serving the media but in the meantime the retail, the international global retail. and IFA without those companies honestly unthinkable because they are presenting new products, ready for the markets and that's the best marketing platform we ever had.
